_note: R36 Talents: earned personal bonuses (traits are birth-only). Slots: base + perTier x class tier, capped at cap; Heir of Vael adds +1 (max 5). fx keys: xp, skillXp{skill}, magicCap, craft (craft speed), injury (chance cut), hunt (meat/hides yield on hunting trips), travel (trip speed), buy (market price), slots. from kinds: class (picked or passed through), guild+rank (guild or craft guild), quest (the member who finished it), tutorial (founder/head when the prologue is complete). Nimble stays a birth trait (+2 AGI, light-armor dodge; the gear overhaul's 'Nimble talent' was shipped as that trait), so it is not duplicated here. Expansions add entries.
